title: Internal Complaints Committee | KPGU
content: ancers, an expert talk by Dr. Dolly Ramnani (M.D. Gynaecology) on the topic  Cervical Cancer, Breast Cancer, & Menstrual Hygiene Awareness  was organized to discuss these critical issues that affect millions of girls and women worldwide. This session helped in increasing knowledge on gynecological issues and necessary screening tests to be done at the earliest among the women, which can help to reduce the incidence of gynaecological cancer.
